Internal helper: a call on a place, assigned back to it

Source: R/utils.R
dot-jst_place_assign_line.Rd

The line that runs for a call given modify = TRUE on a place such as lst$d, which modify cannot change: the call as typed, without its modify argument, assigned to the place – lst$d <- jdeclare_missing(lst$d, W, codes = -99) (Session 352; the S345 item). The form .jst_place_lines() gives an offered line since Session 345, here for the call the user typed.

Usage

.jst_place_assign_line(call, place)

Arguments

call

The call as made, from sys.call() in the exported function.

place

The data argument as typed, a place.

Value

Character(1): one indented line.
